name: Netilat Yadayim (Ritual Hand Washing)
notes: The rabbinic requirement of ritual hand washing before meals and other activities; minimum water quantities, valid vessels, and procedures

name: Tumat Yadayim (Ritual Impurity of Hands)
notes: The rabbinic decree of second-degree impurity on hands, degrees of hand impurity, and what causes it

name: Kitvei HaKodesh Meting'im et HaYadayim (Holy Scriptures Defiling Hands)
notes: The rabbinic decree that canonical Holy Scriptures defile the hands; debates over which books (Song of Songs, Kohelet) are canonical and defile hands

name: Canonicity of Biblical Books
notes: Debates over whether certain books (Shir HaShirim, Kohelet) belong to the biblical canon; the vote at Yavneh

name: Mayim Rishonim and Mayim Shniyim (First and Second Waters for Hand Washing)
notes: The two-stage hand washing process: first water to remove impurity, second water to clean off the first water; laws governing each stage

name: Ammon and Moab in the Seventh Year (Tithes)
notes: Halakhic debate about which tithe applies to Ammon and Moab in the seventh year (maaser ani vs. maaser sheni); methodology of legal analogy

name: Ammonite and Moabite Converts Entering the Congregation
notes: The prohibition against Ammonites and Moabites entering the congregation, and the ruling that since Sennacherib mixed the nations this no longer applies

name: Sennacherib's Mixing of the Nations
notes: The legal principle that Sennacherib's deportations mixed national identities, nullifying national-based prohibitions such as the ban on Ammonites

name: Aramaic Sections in Scripture (Defiling Hands)
notes: Status of Aramaic sections in Ezra and Daniel and their capacity to defile hands; requirement that canonical text be in Assyrian script on parchment in ink

name: Pharisee-Sadducee Halakhic Disputes
notes: Debates between Pharisees and Sadducees on specific halakhic matters: purity of liquids, liability for slaves' damages, defilement of holy scriptures

name: Writing Ruler's Name with Divine Name in a Get
hebrew: שיתוף שם שלטון עם שם שמים בגט
notes: Complaint about writing the ruler's name alongside Moses's name in a get document; Galilean heretic's objection and Pharisaic response

name: Doubt Regarding Hand Impurity (Safek Yadayim)
notes: Rules for cases of doubt whether hands became impure or whether they were purified; the general leniency applied to doubts about hand impurity

name: Disputes with Minim (Heretics)
notes: Recorded debates between rabbis and minim (heretics/sectarians) on halakhic and theological matters

name: Continuous Flow of Liquid (Hashaka / Tziruf)
notes: Dispute between Pharisees and Sadducees whether an uninterrupted stream of liquid connects two vessels for purposes of impurity transmission (nizoq)
